strategyReview: What is working: contract-level premium fades remain the strongest edge — manual PM-IV rich NO live 2/3 +351.7% avg and 9/10 shadows, one-touch live 4/4 +18.4%, PM_IV_GT_OPT_IV clean 3/5 +9.8%, and monotonic arb 33/38. What is failing: many contract trades are still being scored as spot-direction bets, which turns a profitable premium fade into a 0-win spot family; proxy shorts are bleeding; weekend funding threshold-only reversions are unstable; and HYPE/rising-IV confirmation signals are firing late after large BTC rallies rather than before them.

failureClusters.theme: Contract premium fades scored as spot calls
failureClusters.evidence: H-534 gold one-touch cap-edge is 6/21 scorable (29%) with 9 tests burned unscorable, while contract examples show small positive NO premium decay; one-touch shadow overall is 108/280 with -0.82% avg despite live one-touch 4/4 +18.4% and FIND-0020 upside-barrier premium evidence.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as neutral contract premium theses, not spot-decline predictions. Keep entry to tight-spread, near-dated, moderate-edge contracts where the tradable edge actually lives.

failureClusters.evidence: PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/17 with -6.0% avg; FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/23 with -2.94% avg; recent resolved GOLD proxy shorts show -4.88% and -2.5%, with sourceComparison showing opposite_direction correlation in at least one case.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep proxy-short signals in shadow only and require the proxy to track the source direction before promotion. Do not treat identical spot and proxy observations as independent evidence.

failureClusters.evidence: H-535 MU 29%, H-537 AAPL 50%, H-539 CBRS 45% wins; repeated losses show funding staying pinned or falling further, e.g. CBRS -4.3% to -33.8% and MU 5.5% to -28.6%, rather than normalizing.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require a true weekend, relative funding extreme, and evidence funding has already turned higher. Existing refinements such as H-607, H-611, H-619, H-620, and H-621 already test this mechanism; do not re-propose the raw threshold.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 (36%) and btc_listed_iv_momentum_confirmation is 4/18 (22%); HYPE confirmation often echoes already-extended BTC, and some listed-IV variants were graded short against 20%+ BTC rallies.
failureClusters.recommendation: Convert these from directional continuation bets into neutral absolute-move/vol-expansion tests, or require non-crowded funding and room below the 7d high before taking directional long exposure.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: re-author the GOLD one-touch cap-edge signal as a contract premium fade instead of a spot-decline trade. Require moderate underlying-cap edge, near-dated contract, and tight spread.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / buying NO on GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 3 days as premium decays; no GOLD spot move is required.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-108: drop HYPE confirmation and require BTC's own short-term momentum to be constructive but not overcrowded, with room below the 7d high and non-stretched funding.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will rise >2% within 3 days when its own short-term momentum is intact, not already stretched versus the 7d high, and funding is not crowded.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-170: convert rising-IV momentum from a directional long into a neutral absolute-move thesis, because rising listed IV predicts volatility expansion/uncertainty rather than sustained bullish continuation.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot will move at least 2% absolute within 3 days when spot momentum and rising listed option IV coincide.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The gold one-touch cap-edge variant is failing because it was scored as a >2% GOLD spot decline over 2 days, while the tradable signal is overpriced NO/YES premium on the contract. The scorable tests are only 29% and 9 tests are unscorable; contract examples show small positive premium decay even when spot does not fall.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS single-limit funding < -10% fails because the trigger is too broad: 45% of tests see funding stay pinned or fall further, including -4.3% to -33.8% and -6.2% to -33.6%, rather than normalize.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces at least a 2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL < -10% is only 50% and its losses are dominated by flat or positive funding readings that do not normalize; the simple threshold is not a sufficient tail marker.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single AAPL funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and leads to a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU < -10% has repeated 'funding moved 5.5% -> 5.5%' observations and then deterioration to -28.6%; the raw threshold captures noise rather than identifying true weekend reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Cross-asset HYPE confirmation produced only 9/25 wins because HYPE risk-on echoed late-stage BTC strength instead of providing independent confirmation; winners were large but too infrequent.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The listed-IV momentum long family is at 22% and the test outputs show direction whipsaw—some variants were graded as short and lost while BTC rallied over 20%. The persistent signal is volatility expansion, not bullish direction.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot momentum confirmed by rising options IV reliably leads to further >2% gains within 3-7 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 0/29 is now conclusive that PM-IV richness alone does not make near-expiry OIL above-strike YES premium decay; rich IV can coincide with continued spot drift toward the barrier.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: Rich PM IV on near-expiry OIL above-strike one-touch YES implies premium decay within 3 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is re-framing: contract premium edges must be tested as contract P&L, not spot calls. H-534 and several one-touch families burned tests because the prediction was a >2% spot move rather than premium decay. Weekend funding thresholds need a weekend/turn/percentile filter; existing active refinements already encode that, so no new threshold variants were authored. Proxy shorts remain weak and should stay in shadow. The new hypotheses prioritize neutral NO/YES premium fades from outcome-panel findings and one-touch BTC/GOLD refinements, plus neutral absolute-move fixes for failed momentum/IV confirmation.
